tiles.markdownText:
# Glass Box Dashboard - AI Agent Observability & Cost Governance

Monitoring blueprint for **four agent types** that interact with **Dynamics 365 Business Central**, built on Application Insights telemetry. **All timestamps are UTC.**

| Page | Agent(s) | Platform | Telemetry source |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Logic Apps Agent** | Customer Service / Sales / Refund (multi-agent) | Azure Logic Apps Standard | `traces`, `dependencies`, `requests` (role `multiagentpatterns`) |
| **MCS Agent** | Inventory Agent | Microsoft Copilot Studio | `customEvents`, `dependencies` (role `Microsoft Copilot Studio`) |
| **Foundry Agent** | Hotel Concierge (hotel search + booking + BC invoice) | Azure AI Foundry (OpenTelemetry) | `dependencies`, `requests`, `traces`, `genAIContent` (role `DirectionsEMEAConciergeAgent`) |
| **BC Agent** | MTG Agent (agent tasks + Scryfall card lookup) | Dynamics 365 Business Central (in-app agent) | `traces` component `Dynamics 365 Business Central Server`; events `LC0068/LC0043/RT0055/RT0019/LC0066` |
| **Cost & Governance** | All agents | Cross-platform | Cumulative tokens, credits, cost, activity & coverage |

The left *Tables* tile shows the raw telemetry item types ingested for the period.

tiles.title: Overview
tiles.markdownText:
# Logic Apps Agent - Multi-Agent Customer Service

A 3-agent handoff system running on **Azure Logic Apps Standard** (`HandoffCustomerServiceWorkflow`, cloud role `multiagentpatterns`) powered by **Azure OpenAI gpt-4.1**.

- **Customer_Service_Agent** - front door; triages every customer request.
- **Sales_Specialist** - handles product / purchase questions (handoff from Customer Service).
- **Refund_Specialist** - handles refunds (handoff from Customer Service).

Token usage is emitted per agent turn through the `WorkflowAgentLoopExecutionCompleted` event (`prompt`/`completionTokenCount`); tool calls and agent handoffs are captured in `toolResults`.

> **Cost model** (editable in each query): gpt-4.1 input **$2.00 / 1M** tokens, output **$8.00 / 1M** tokens.

tiles.title: Activity
tiles.markdownText:
## What each agent did - activity log
Every agent turn (LLM loop) with prompt / completion tokens, number of tool calls and the tool / handoff result. Read top-down to follow the *Customer Service -> Sales / Refund* handoff flow.

tiles.title: Tokens
tiles.markdownText:
## Token consumption per agent (summarized)
LLM calls, prompt / completion / total tokens and **estimated USD cost** aggregated per agent. The column chart (left) compares total token volume; the table (right) breaks down tokens and cost. `Sales_Specialist` is typically the most expensive specialist here.

tiles.title: TokensTime
tiles.markdownText:
## Token usage over time
Total tokens per 10-second bin, split by agent. Shows the burst pattern and how prompt size grows along the handoff chain (context accumulates from ~1.3k to ~3.5k tokens per call).

tiles.title: Tools
tiles.markdownText:
## Agent handoffs & tool calls
Only turns that produced a tool result. Values such as `CustomerServiceHandoff -> HandedOff` and `RefundSpecialistHandoff -> HandedOff` are **orchestration handoffs** between agents; `execute_refund -> Succeeded` is a **business action** executed against the backend.

tiles.title: Latency
tiles.markdownText:
## Model duration - Azure OpenAI gpt-4.1
Duration of every `chat/completions` dependency call. Table (left) = call count and P50 / P95 / Max latency; chart (right) = per-call duration over time. Model duration is the main driver of end-user response time.

tiles.title: Errors
tiles.markdownText:
## Errors & reliability
Function timeouts (`exceptions`) and workflow `EdgeError` events. Use this to catch cascading failures and runs that exceeded the 30-minute Azure Functions timeout (`Functions.AgentsVersioned`).

tiles.title: Overview
tiles.markdownText:
# Copilot Studio Agent - Inventory Agent

A **Microsoft Copilot Studio** agent (cloud role `Microsoft Copilot Studio`) answering inventory questions against **Dynamics 365 Business Central** through the BC connector.

Telemetry here is conversation-centric: `BotMessageReceived` / `BotMessageSend` events (with message text), topic events, and `dependency` calls to the Business Central connector.

> **Note - observability gap:** Copilot Studio does **not** emit LLM token counts in this telemetry, so per-token cost cannot be computed from App Insights. Govern cost by **messages / sessions / connector calls** instead, and reconcile spend with Copilot Studio capacity / billing reports.

tiles.title: Transcript
tiles.markdownText:
## Conversation transcript - what the agent did
Full turn-by-turn transcript for the session. `User -> Agent` rows are the questions asked (items under stock, lowest / highest stock, most costly item, reorder point); `Agent -> User` rows are the answers returned from Business Central data.

tiles.title: Summary
tiles.markdownText:
## Activity summary
Conversation volume at a glance: user messages, agent messages, distinct topics and conversations (left), plus Business Central connector call statistics (right).

tiles.title: BC
tiles.markdownText:
## Business Central connector performance
Every `Dynamics 365 Business Central` connector dependency with duration, success flag and result code. 
These calls are the agent's data-retrieval latency against BC - watch the slow outliers, if any -.

tiles.title: LatencyTurn
tiles.markdownText:
## Response duration per turn
Time between each user question and the agent's reply, in seconds. Tall bars = slow answers; correlate with the connector calls above to find the cause.

tiles.title: Overview
tiles.markdownText:
# Cost & Governance - All Agents (Cumulative)

Cross-agent rollup for financial governance and observability coverage. Cards show cumulative LLM usage and estimated spend; charts compare cost, tokens and activity across agent platforms.

**Scope:** Measure workloads across **four agents**:
- **Logic Apps** multi-agent (gpt-4.1) - full token + cost telemetry.
- **Foundry** hotel concierge (gpt-5.4-mini) - full token + cost telemetry, **with prompt caching**.
- **Copilot Studio** Inventory Agent - activity only, **no token telemetry**.
- **BC Agent** MTG Agent (GPT-5.5 Chat) - runs **inside Business Central**, billed in **Copilot credits** (`RT0055`).

> **Cost model** (editable in queries): gpt-4.1 **$2 / $8** per 1M (in/out); gpt-5.4-mini **$0.25 / $0.025 / $2** per 1M (input / cached input / output); BC agent **$0.01 / Copilot credit** (placeholder - edit to contract).

tiles.title: Exec
tiles.markdownText:
## Executions per agent type
Share of agent executions by platform - Logic Apps agent turns, Copilot Studio user turns, Foundry chat completions, and **BC agent tasks** (`LC0068`). Pie (left) = distribution; table (right) = counts.

tiles.title: Cost
tiles.markdownText:
## Cumulative token consumption & cost
Per-agent breakdown (left) and grand total (right) of prompt / completion / total tokens with estimated USD cost (gpt-4.1). This is the detailed + summarized cumulative view for budgeting.

tiles.title: Timeline
tiles.markdownText:
## Activity timeline - all agents
Telemetry events per minute by cloud role. Four separated agents: Logic Apps, Copilot Studio , Foundry and the BC Agent.

tiles.title: Checklist
tiles.markdownText:
## Observability coverage & governance checklist

| Signal | Logic Apps (gpt-4.1) | Copilot Studio | Foundry (gpt-5.4-mini) | BC Agent (GPT-5.5 Chat) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Request / turn visibility | Yes - loop events, `requests` | Yes - `BotMessage*` | Yes - `requests`, `invoke_agent` | Yes - agent tasks `LC0068`/`LC0043` |
| Token usage | **Yes** | **No** - not in telemetry | **Yes** - OTel `gen_ai.usage.*` | **No** - credit-based (`copilotCredits`) |
| Prompt caching visibility | No | n/a | **Yes** - `cache_read.input_tokens` | n/a |
| Cost unit | Per-token | Messages / sessions | Per-token | **Per Copilot credit** (`RT0055`) |
| Tool / handoff tracing | Yes - `toolResults` | Partial - topic events | Yes - `execute_tool` deps | Yes - external API `RT0019`, OData `RT0008` |
| Model latency | Yes - OpenAI dep duration | n/a (managed) | Yes - dep duration + TTFC | Partial - task duration `LC0043` |
| Backend (BC) action | n/a | Yes - connector dependency | Yes - reservation + invoice sim | **Native** - runs inside BC |
| Errors / throttling | Yes - exceptions, EdgeError | Dependency `success` flag | Yes - dep `success`, exceptions | Yes - task `result`, `failureCodeunit` |
| Config / prompt audit | Partial | Partial | Partial | **Yes** - `LC0066` (state, model, instructions hash) |

**Governance recommendations**
1. Set **budget alerts** on cumulative estimated cost, prompt-token growth (Logic Apps / Foundry) **and Copilot-credit consumption** (BC agent `RT0055`).
2. Exploit **prompt caching** (Foundry): cached input is ~10x cheaper - track cache hit rate as a cost KPI.
3. Alert on **function timeouts** / `EdgeError` (Logic Apps), failed `execute_tool` / reservation events (Foundry), and **failed agent tasks** / `failureCodeunit` (BC agent).
4. Track **P95 model latency**, **time-to-first-chunk** (Foundry) and **agent-task duration** (BC) as responsiveness SLOs.
5. For Copilot Studio, govern by **messages / sessions / connector latency**; for BC agents, reconcile spend via **Copilot credits**.
6. Keep **per-agent attribution** to spot the most expensive agent (Logic Apps `Sales_Specialist`; Foundry concierge; BC MTG Agent credits).
7. For autonomous in-BC agents, monitor **config changes** (`LC0066` enable/disable + instructions hash) as a compliance trail.

tiles.title: Overview
tiles.markdownText:
# Foundry Agent - Hotel Concierge (DirectionsEMEAConciergeAgent)

An **Azure AI Foundry** agent (cloud role `DirectionsEMEAConciergeAgent`, model **gpt-5.4-mini**) instrumented with **OpenTelemetry GenAI** semantic conventions. It simulates a **hotel search in Paris**, **reserves a room**, and triggers a **simulated posted invoice in Business Central**.

- **LLM calls:** `dependencies` where `gen_ai.operation.name == "chat"` - tokens in `gen_ai.usage.*` (input / output / **cache_read** / reasoning).
- **Tools:** `execute_tool GetAvailableHotels`, `execute_tool ReserveHotel`; agent orchestration via `invoke_agent hotel-concierge`.
- **Business action:** `reservation.confirmation.*` trace events carry the BC invoice simulation (`is_simulated`, `duration_ms`).

The tables below (existing) show raw agent traces, tool calls, token usage and confirmed bookings; the governance section adds **cost, caching, latency and tool/reservation** views.

tiles.title: f_tokhdr
tiles.markdownText:
## Token usage & cost (gpt-5.4-mini)
Left: token totals and **estimated cost** per model, separating **billable** input from **cached** input. Right: per-call token breakdown over time - the large cached-input band shows prompt caching keeping cost low.

tiles.title: f_cachehdr
tiles.markdownText:
## Prompt caching efficiency
gpt-5.4-mini reuses large system/tool context across turns. Cached input tokens are billed ~10x cheaper, so a high cache-hit rate is a direct cost lever.

tiles.title: f_lathdr
tiles.markdownText:
## Model duration & streaming performance
Left: call count with P50 / P95 / Max latency and average time-to-first-chunk (streaming responsiveness). Right: per-call duration over time.

tiles.title: f_toolhdr
tiles.markdownText:
## Tool calls & hotel reservations (with BC invoice simulation)
Every `execute_tool` call (GetAvailableHotels / ReserveHotel) with duration and success and reservation lifecycle events, including the **simulated Business Central posted invoice** (`Simulated`, duration).

tiles.title: g_catchy
tiles.markdownText:
## Cost & token distribution (at a glance)
Left: **estimated cost share** by agent (donut) - who drives spend (BC agent cost derived from Copilot credits). Right: **token mix** by agent - billable input vs cached input vs output; Foundry's tall cached band visualises caching savings, while Copilot Studio and the **BC agent** show zero (credit-based, no token telemetry).

tiles.title: bc_overview
tiles.markdownText:
# BC Agent - MTG Agent (in Business Central)

An **autonomous agent running inside Dynamics 365 Business Central** (environment `GlassBox`, company `CRONUS IT`). Extension **DT.MTGAgent**, agent user **MTG AGENT - CRONUS IT**, model **GPT-5.5 Chat** (`GPT-55-CHAT-LATEST`, default). Unlike the cloud agents, it is **billed in Copilot credits** (not tokens) and runs natively on the BC Server.

- **Agent tasks:** `traces` eventId `LC0068` (task created, model) -> `LC0040` (scheduled) -> `LC0043` (completed, result + duration).
- **AI consumption / cost:** eventId `RT0055` *"AI Consumption Recorded"* carries `copilotCredits`, `featureName`, `agentTaskId`.
- **Copilot capability:** eventId `AL0000LLW` *"Action invoked on Copilot Capability"* (success, user role, license).
- **External tools:** eventId `RT0019` outgoing web service (e.g. **Scryfall** card API via `DTM Scryfall Mgt.`) + `RT0008` OData.
- **Governance & audit:** `LC0066` agent config changes (enable/disable, model, instructions hash), `AL0000CTE` sensitive-field changes.

> **Cost model (editable in queries):** BC agents consume **Copilot credits**; `creditUsd` placeholder = **$0.01 / credit** - edit to your contract. All timestamps are UTC.

tiles.title: bc_kpihdr
tiles.markdownText:
## Key metrics
Agent throughput, Copilot-credit consumption and estimated spend, task reliability, Copilot capability usage, and external API activity for the in-BC agent.

tiles.title: bc_taskhdr
tiles.markdownText:
## Agent tasks
Left: tasks created with the selected model. Middle: task executions with result, duration and SQL load. Right: outcome split (success vs failure) - the core reliability signal for an unattended agent.

tiles.title: bc_costhdr
tiles.markdownText:
## AI consumption & cost (Copilot credits)
Business Central meters agent AI usage as **Copilot credits** (`RT0055`). Left: credits by billed feature / extension. Right: credit consumption over time - the primary cost-governance signal for BC agents.

tiles.title: bc_toolhdr
tiles.markdownText:
## Copilot capability & external tools
Left: every Copilot capability invocation (success, user role, license state). Right: outgoing API calls the agent makes (e.g. the **Scryfall** card API via `DTM Scryfall Mgt.`) with HTTP status and duration.

tiles.title: bc_govhdr
tiles.markdownText:
## Governance & audit
Agent configuration changes - enable/disable, model switches and the **instructions hash** (prompt integrity).

tiles.title: bc_glancehdr
tiles.markdownText:
## Activity at a glance
Left: share of agent telemetry by category (tasks, AI consumption, Copilot actions, external API, governance). Right: BC agent activity per minute - the execution burst for the run window.

queries.text:
union *
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize count() by itemType
//| summarize count() by name, category, counter

traces
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == ("DirectionsEMEAConciergeAgent") or cloud_RoleName contains "FoundryAgent" 
| project timestamp, severityLevel, message, operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc

// Tool calls:
union requests, dependencies
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == ("DirectionsEMEAConciergeAgent") or cloud_RoleName contains "FoundryAgent" 
| where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "execute_tool"
| extend description = tostring(customDimensions.["gen_ai.tool.description"])
| project timestamp, name, description, duration = round(duration,1), success, operation_Id, customDimensions
| order by timestamp desc

// Token usage
union requests, dependencies
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == ("DirectionsEMEAConciergeAgent") or cloud_RoleName contains "FoundryAgent" 
| extend inputTokens = tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
         outputTokens = tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| where isnotnull(inputTokens) or isnotnull(outputTokens)
| project timestamp, name, inputTokens, outputTokens, operation_Id

// Custom reservation signals
traces
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == ("DirectionsEMEAConciergeAgent") or cloud_RoleName contains "FoundryAgent" 
| where tostring(customDimensions["event_name"]) startswith "reservation.confirmation."
| extend eventName = tostring(customDimensions["event_name"]),
         phase = tostring(customDimensions["phase"]),
         outcome = tostring(customDimensions["outcome"]),
         durationMs = round(toreal(customDimensions["duration_ms"]),0),
         isSimulated = tobool(customDimensions["is_simulated"]),
         tool = tostring(customDimensions.tool_name),
         reservationId = tostring(customDimensions.simulation_id)
| project timestamp, eventName, phase, tool, outcome, durationMs,  
          isSimulated, reservationId, operation_Id, operation_ParentId
| order by timestamp asc

//Prenotazioni albergo confermate
traces
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == ("DirectionsEMEAConciergeAgent") or cloud_RoleName contains "FoundryAgent" 
| where tostring(customDimensions["event_name"]) == "reservation.confirmation.completed"
| where tostring(customDimensions["outcome"]) == "success"
| project
    timestamp,
    agentName = cloud_RoleName,
    reservationId = tostring(customDimensions["simulation_id"]),
    durationMs = round(toreal(customDimensions["duration_ms"]),0),
    isConfirmed = true,
    operation_Id,
    operation_ParentId
| order by timestamp desc

// Logic Apps multi-agent: one row per agent turn (LLM loop)
traces
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == "multiagentpatterns"
| where tostring(customDimensions.EventName) == "WorkflowAgentLoopExecutionCompleted"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions.prop__actionName)
| extend PromptTokens = tolong(customDimensions.prop__promptTokenCount)
| extend CompletionTokens = tolong(customDimensions.prop__completionTokenCount)
| extend ToolCount = tolong(customDimensions.prop__toolCount)
| extend ToolResults = tostring(customDimensions.prop__toolResults)
| extend RunId = tostring(customDimensions.prop__flowRunSequenceId)
| extend TotalTokens = PromptTokens + CompletionTokens
| project timestamp, Agent, PromptTokens, CompletionTokens, TotalTokens, ToolCount, ToolResults, RunId, operation_Id
| order by timestamp asc

// Total tokens consumed per agent
traces
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == "multiagentpatterns"
| where tostring(customDimensions.EventName) == "WorkflowAgentLoopExecutionCompleted"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions.prop__actionName)
| extend TotalTokens = tolong(customDimensions.prop__promptTokenCount) + tolong(customDimensions.prop__completionTokenCount)
| summarize TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens) by Agent
| order by TotalTokens desc

// Token consumption and estimated cost per agent (gpt-4.1)
let inputPricePer1M = 2.0;    // USD per 1M input tokens - edit to your contract
let outputPricePer1M = 8.0;   // USD per 1M output tokens - edit to your contract
traces
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == "multiagentpatterns"
| where tostring(customDimensions.EventName) == "WorkflowAgentLoopExecutionCompleted"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions.prop__actionName)
| extend PromptTokens = tolong(customDimensions.prop__promptTokenCount)
| extend CompletionTokens = tolong(customDimensions.prop__completionTokenCount)
| summarize ['LLM Calls'] = count(), ['Prompt Tokens'] = sum(PromptTokens), ['Completion Tokens'] = sum(CompletionTokens) by Agent
| extend ['Total Tokens'] = ['Prompt Tokens'] + ['Completion Tokens']
| extend ['Est. Cost (USD)'] = round(['Prompt Tokens'] / 1000000.0 * inputPricePer1M + ['Completion Tokens'] / 1000000.0 * outputPricePer1M, 4)
| order by ['Total Tokens'] desc

// Tokens over time, split by agent
traces
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == "multiagentpatterns"
| where tostring(customDimensions.EventName) == "WorkflowAgentLoopExecutionCompleted"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions.prop__actionName)
| extend TotalTokens = tolong(customDimensions.prop__promptTokenCount) + tolong(customDimensions.prop__completionTokenCount)
| summarize TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens) by bin(timestamp, 10s), Agent
| order by timestamp asc

// Agent handoffs and business tool calls
traces
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == "multiagentpatterns"
| where tostring(customDimensions.EventName) == "WorkflowAgentLoopExecutionCompleted"
| extend Agent = tostring(customDimensions.prop__actionName)
| extend ToolCount = tolong(customDimensions.prop__toolCount)
| extend ToolResults = tostring(customDimensions.prop__toolResults)
| where ToolCount > 0 and ToolResults != "{}"
| project timestamp, Agent, ToolResults, operation_Id
| order by timestamp asc

// Azure OpenAI gpt-4.1 latency summary
dependencies
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == "multiagentpatterns"
| where name has "openai" and name has "chat/completions"
| extend Model = extract(@"deployments/([^/]+)/", 1, name)
| summarize ['Calls'] = count(), ['Avg ms'] = round(avg(duration), 1), ['P50 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 50), 1), ['P95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 95), 1), ['Max ms'] = round(max(duration), 1) by Model, ['Endpoint'] = target

// Per-call model latency over time
dependencies
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == "multiagentpatterns"
| where name has "openai" and name has "chat/completions"
| project timestamp, DurationMs = duration
| order by timestamp asc

// Errors, timeouts and workflow edge errors
union
  (exceptions
   | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where cloud_RoleName == "multiagentpatterns"
   | project timestamp, Kind = "Exception", Detail = outerMessage, operation_Id),
  (traces
   | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
   | where cloud_RoleName == "multiagentpatterns"
   | where tostring(customDimensions.EventName) == "EdgeError"
   | project timestamp, Kind = "EdgeError", Detail = message, operation_Id)
| order by timestamp desc

// Copilot Studio Inventory Agent - conversation transcript
customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == "Microsoft Copilot Studio"
| where name in ("BotMessageReceived", "BotMessageSend")
| extend Direction = iff(name == "BotMessageReceived", "User -> Agent", "Agent -> User")
| extend Message = tostring(customDimensions.text)
| extend ConversationId = tostring(customDimensions.conversationId)
| project timestamp, Direction, Message, ConversationId
| order by timestamp asc

// Copilot Studio activity summary
customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == "Microsoft Copilot Studio"
| summarize ['User Messages'] = countif(name == "BotMessageReceived"),
            ['Agent Messages'] = countif(name == "BotMessageSend"),
            ['Topics Started'] = countif(name == "TopicStart"),
            ['Conversations'] = dcount(tostring(customDimensions.conversationId))

// Business Central connector call statistics
dependencies
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == "Microsoft Copilot Studio"
| where type == "Connector"
| summarize ['BC Calls'] = count(), ['Avg ms'] = round(avg(duration), 0), ['P95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0), ['Max ms'] = round(max(duration), 0), ['Failures'] = countif(success == false)

// Business Central connector calls detail
dependencies
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == "Microsoft Copilot Studio"
| where name == "Dynamics 365 Business Central"
| project timestamp, Target = target, ['Duration ms'] = duration, Success = success, ResultCode = resultCode
| order by timestamp asc

// Response latency per conversation turn (user question -> agent reply)
customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where cloud_RoleName == "Microsoft Copilot Studio"
| where name in ("BotMessageReceived", "BotMessageSend")
| extend Text = tostring(customDimensions.text)
| order by timestamp asc
| extend PrevTime = prev(timestamp), PrevName = prev(name), PrevText = prev(Text)
| where name == "BotMessageSend" and PrevName == "BotMessageReceived"
| extend ResponseSeconds = round(datetime_diff('millisecond', timestamp, PrevTime) / 1000.0, 1)
| project timestamp, UserQuestion = PrevText, ResponseSeconds
| order by timestamp asc

// Cumulative LLM / model calls across all agents (incl. BC Copilot actions)
union
  (traces      
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime) 
    | where cloud_RoleName == "multiagentpatterns" 
    | where tostring(customDimensions.EventName) == "WorkflowAgentLoopExecutionCompleted"),
  (dependencies
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime) 
    | where cloud_RoleName == ("DirectionsEMEAConciergeAgent") 
      or cloud_RoleName contains "FoundryAgent" 
    | where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "chat"),
  (traces
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime) 
    | where tostring(customDimensions.eventId) == "AL0000LLW")
| summarize ['LLM Calls'] = count()

// Cumulative input/prompt tokens (Logic Apps gpt-4.1 + Foundry gpt-5.4-mini)
let la = toscalar(traces 
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime) 
    | where cloud_RoleName == "multiagentpatterns" 
    | where tostring(customDimensions.EventName) == "WorkflowAgentLoopExecutionCompleted" 
    | summarize sum(tolong(customDimensions.prop__promptTokenCount)));
let fnd = toscalar(dependencies 
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime) 
    | where cloud_RoleName == ("DirectionsEMEAConciergeAgent") 
        or cloud_RoleName contains "FoundryAgent" 
    | where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "chat" 
    | summarize sum(tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"])));
print ['Input / Prompt Tokens'] = la + fnd

// Executions per agent type (cross-platform, incl. BC agent tasks)
union
  (traces       
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where cloud_RoleName == "multiagentpatterns" 
    | where tostring(customDimensions.EventName) == "WorkflowAgentLoopExecutionCompleted" 
    | extend AgentType = "Logic Apps (gpt-4.1)"),
  (customEvents 
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where cloud_RoleName == "Microsoft Copilot Studio" 
    | where name == "BotMessageReceived" 
    | extend AgentType = "Copilot Studio (Inventory)"),
  (dependencies 
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where cloud_RoleName == ("DirectionsEMEAConciergeAgent") 
        or cloud_RoleName contains "FoundryAgent" 
    | where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "chat" 
    | extend AgentType = "Foundry (gpt-5.4-mini)"),
  (traces
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where tostring(customDimensions.eventId) == "LC0068" 
    | extend AgentType = "BC Agent (GPT-5.5 Chat)")
| summarize Executions = count() by AgentType
| order by Executions desc

// Executions per agent type (cross-platform, incl. BC agent tasks)
union
  (traces       
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where cloud_RoleName == "multiagentpatterns" 
    | where tostring(customDimensions.EventName) == "WorkflowAgentLoopExecutionCompleted" 
    | extend AgentType = "Logic Apps (gpt-4.1)"),
  (customEvents 
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where cloud_RoleName == "Microsoft Copilot Studio" 
    | where name == "BotMessageReceived" 
    | extend AgentType = "Copilot Studio (Inventory)"),
  (dependencies 
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where cloud_RoleName == ("DirectionsEMEAConciergeAgent")
